suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Bath and brush
suggested_services.example: The main story: a $35 bath and brush for Biscuit, priced by his size and coat. A card is saved for the salon's $20 fee and the late pick-up fee. Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Bath and brush
suggested_services.example: The same $35 bath and brush for a pet the salon knows. Nothing is taken: a YES books it. Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

suggested_services.name: Matted coat groom
suggested_services.example: A matted coat, priced at drop-off once Jamal sees it: a $110 shave-down and a $15 tidy. Only the $25 coat check is promised. A card is saved for the $20 fee.

suggested_services.name: Full groom in the van
suggested_services.example: The main story: a $179 full groom in the van for Maple. A card is saved for the $89 fee, and charged $179 when Nico texts DONE.

suggested_services.name: Full groom in the van
suggested_services.example: The same $179 van groom. A card is saved for the $89 fee. Rosie texts the bill after, with a tip line.

suggested_services.name: Matted coat groom in the van
suggested_services.example: A matted coat, priced at the van door: a $165 shave-down and an $80 skin-soothing bath. Only the $89 van visit is promised. The card is charged at DONE.

services_listed_in_profession_file.before: a card saved for the fees
services_listed_in_profession_file.after: at the counter; in the van, the saved card at DONE

before_times: Dog or cat, the breed, and about how much the pet weighs
The coat: when it was last groomed, and any mats (a few spots, or tight to the skin)
Has the pet ever bitten or snapped at a groomer?
For the van: the town or ZIP, and a place to park a 24-foot van
after_time: The style wanted, like a teddy bear face or ears left long
Trouble with nails, dryers or being handled?
Anything the groomer should know, like a sore hip
secure_page_only: The pet's rabies certificate, or a vet's written exemption
The pet's private health notes, like seizures or a heart murmur
An emergency contact the salon may call (never texted)
The matted-coat release, and a muzzle OK for a pet with a bite history
Someone else who may pick the pet up, named in writing
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult: the pet's owner, or someone the owner names; a teen sends it to a parent

stop: a person hurt, or a fire
a pet that's bleeding, can't breathe, collapsed or had a seizure
safety_and_stop_words.go_on: no for a hurt or sick pet; yes for everything else
safety_and_stop_words.stop_action: a person in danger: 'call 911' and the generic emergency steps. A pet in danger: the nearest emergency vet the salon named, and no booking

prep: Bring the rabies certificate if it isn't on file yet
Tell us about any new lumps, sores or health changes
For the van: a parking space, and the pet ready on a leash
first_steps_and_forms.required: before a first groom: the pet's rabies proof, good on the groom day, on the secure page; or a vet's written exemption

staff.licenses_or_certificates: none for each groomer unless the state's form says so; the business holds the grooming license where the state has one
staff.supervision: a groomer in training works only while a groomer who may supervise them is on, where the owner sets it
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs new pets with mats or a bite history, matted-coat prices, fees, and anything priced at the visit
staff.stand_in: only a groomer with the skill for that coat or pet, like cats or a bite history

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult: the pet's owner, or someone the owner names; a teen sends it to a parent
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts about a pet a teen asked for go to the parent who booked

visit.check_in: a drop-off: the owner gives the check-in code at the counter when leaving the pet. The van: the code at the van door, as at any door
visit.done: the drop-off code checks the pet in; READY and the pick-up close it; in the van, the code at the door and DONE
visit.changes_at_visit: anything not agreed at drop-off, like a flea bath, needs the owner's yes by text with its price; no answer in 15 minutes: the owner calls; still no yes: finished without it

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: if: where the state licenses grooming businesses (some do, vans and trailers too); none where the state has no grooming license
license.who: the business: the salon and each van; groomers need none of their own unless the state's form says so
ask: The salon's grooming license number, where the state has one
The van's or trailer's own license or permit, where the state's rules require one
A local business or kennel permit, where only a city or county asks for one
license.insurance: groomer's liability and care of the pets in its keeping, as the business says; shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: An injury or a nick: the owner calls
